title: Password Strength Checker
metaDescription: Check how strong your password is with our free tool. Get instant feedback and tips to create uncrackable passwords.
description: Enter a password to check its strength. This tool analyzes length, complexity, and common patterns locally in your browser.

educational.howItWorks: This tool analyzes your password based on length, character variety, common patterns, and dictionary words. All analysis happens locally in your browser.
tips: Mix uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols
Avoid dictionary words and personal information
Use a different password for every account
commonMistakes: Reusing the same password across sites
